title: Esquilache Riots
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Esquilache Riots", at revision 1366228869, opens: "The Esquilache Riots occurred in March 1766 during the rule of Charles III of Spain." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1883498, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1766 Spanish riots". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
